visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up shot of a pair of hands holding a dark, textured folding knife against a blurred background of a yellow outdoor tent and green foliage. The person's fingers are positioned to deploy the blade, revealing a smooth metallic pivot. The lighting is bright and natural, suggesting an outdoor daylight setting. (2) The camera pulls back to a medium shot of an Asian male with short dark hair, wearing a dark gray long-sleeved shirt and a tactical-style watch on his left wrist. He smiles slightly at the camera while holding the opened knife, which has a distinct leaf-shaped blade with a thumb hole. The background shows a yellow camping tent and the edge of a flowing stream with lush green trees. (3) A sequence of extreme close-up shots follows, focusing on the knife handle's material, which shows a marbled, shredded carbon fiber texture with high-contrast patterns. The man's hands demonstrate the mechanical operation of the knife, specifically the frame lock and the pocket clip. (4) The man proceeds to demonstrate four different ways to open the knife. Each method is shown in a tight close-up, focusing on the interaction between his fingers and the blade's features (flipper tab, thumb hole). His facial expressions remain focused and informative as he looks directly into the lens during the transitions between demonstrations. (5) The final segment shows the man holding the knife horizontally to show its profile, then folding it closed using one hand. He continues to speak, gesturing with the closed knife before the video concludes with the knife held open once more, highlighting its sleek design against the natural backdrop.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a calm, friendly male voice speaking in Traditional Chinese over a gentle, steady acoustic guitar track. A soft natural outdoor ambience, characterized by a low-level river sound and room tone, is present in the mix. (2) A sharp, metallic mechanical click is heard, indicating the deployment of a tool. The speaker's pitch remains mid-range and steady as he describes material specifications. (3) Another metallic click sounds as the speaker transitions into demonstrating opening mechanisms. The background music maintains its consistent tempo. (4) A series of rhythmic mechanical clicks occur in rapid succession, punctuating the demonstration of various opening methods. Each click has a bright spectral transient. (5) A final metallic click and sliding friction sound occur as the tool is folded. A subtle digital pop SFX marks the final call to action as the narration ends with an upbeat tone.
